description: Source code for supported video profile and resolution detection on Windows using Direct3D 11, including functions to check device support for various video codecs and profiles, primarily for media decoding support in Chromium.

methods.name: IsResolutionSupportedForDevice
methods.description: Checks if a specific resolution is supported by the video device for a given decoder GUID and format.

methods.name: GetResolutionsForGUID
methods.description: Determines the range of supported resolutions for a specific decoder GUID on a given video device.

methods.name: GetSupportedD3D11VideoDecoderResolutions
methods.description: Main function that returns supported video decoder resolutions for various profiles on a D3D11 device.
